description: iTalk-iSee is a participatory visual learning analytics tool developed by Hu, Wu, and Chen that codes and visualizes peer talk to support student reflection and regulation of discourse engagement.
title: iTalk-iSee

description: iTalk2Learn is an EU-funded adaptive digital learning platform that combines an exploratory learning environment with an intelligent tutoring system and sequences activities using student interaction data.
title: iTalk2Learn

description: ITAP is a data-driven intelligent tutoring system developed by Kelly Rivers and colleagues that generates personalized next-step hints for novice programmers solving code-writing problems.
title: ITAP (Intelligent Teaching Assistant for Programming)

description: ITAS is a conversational analytics agent that helps instructors and content developers query privacy-preserving aggregate learning-deployment data in natural language.
title: ITAS conversational instructor analytics agent

description: iTELL is a computational framework and interactive intelligent-textbook web application developed by Morris et al.
title: iTELL (Intelligent Textbook for Enhanced Language Learning)

description: A Unity-built educational VR game application developed by Friday Joseph Agbo and colleagues for Nigerian higher-education students, using three computational-thinking mini games and real-time competency logging.
title: iThinkSmart VR game-based application

description: ITSS is a web-based intelligent tutoring system for grades K–8 that teaches students to recognize and use factual-text structures through animated modeling, self-paced practice, and immediate feedback.
title: ITSS
